sections.title: Bank of America AI
sections.description: Bank of America (Charlotte HQ) — the US's second-largest bank with $3.3T+ in assets.

blocks.heading: Erica AI enhancement
paragraphs: ML for improving and expanding Bank of America's Erica virtual assistant — the voice and text AI assistant that BofA has deployed to its 35+ million customers for account inquiries, transaction guidance, and financial wellness coaching. Erica's scale — handling millions of customer interactions daily — creates ML requirements for conversation quality, intent classification accuracy, and personalization that are among the most demanding in consumer banking.

blocks.heading: Consumer credit risk ML
paragraphs: ML for Bank of America's large consumer lending portfolio — credit card, auto, home equity, and mortgage credit risk analytics at the scale and regulatory oversight of the US's second-largest consumer lender, with CFPB, OCC, and Federal Reserve model risk governance (SR 11-7) requirements.

blocks.heading: CCAR stress testing analytics
paragraphs: ML for Bank of America's Comprehensive Capital Analysis and Review (CCAR) stress testing models — the Federal Reserve's bank stress testing framework requires advanced credit risk and net revenue models that ClickMasters builds with Federal Reserve model risk validation requirements.

sections.title: Truist Financial AI
sections.description: Truist Financial (Charlotte HQ) — the post-merger integration of BB&T and SunTrust into the US's sixth-largest bank.

blocks.heading: Post-merger model harmonization
paragraphs: ML for Truist's ongoing challenge of harmonizing the credit, risk, and customer analytics models that BB&T and SunTrust had developed independently before their 2019 merger — identifying model conflicts, harmonizing feature definitions, and building unified models that reflect Truist's combined customer base.

blocks.heading: Southeast community banking ML
paragraphs: ML calibrated to Truist's Southeast US customer base — the Southeast's specific demographics (aging population in Florida retirement markets, younger working-class demographics in Appalachian and rural Southeast communities) create credit risk and customer analytics patterns that national models systematically misfit.

sections.title: LendingTree and Online Lending Marketplace AI
sections.description: LendingTree (Charlotte HQ) — the US's largest online lending marketplace connecting borrowers with lenders.

blocks.heading: Loan match optimization ML
paragraphs: ML for LendingTree's core marketplace matching — predicting which lenders to surface for specific borrower profiles to maximize both conversion rate and borrower-lender match quality for the platform's millions of annual loan inquiries.

blocks.heading: Credit risk pre-screening analytics
paragraphs: ML for the pre-screening that helps LendingTree's lender partners identify which consumer inquiries represent qualified borrowers before investing in full credit inquiry and underwriting.

sections.title: Charlotte InsurTech and Catastrophe Analytics
sections.description: For the North Carolina-domiciled insurers addressing the Carolinas' catastrophe risk market.

blocks.heading: Carolinas hurricane and wind risk ML
paragraphs: ML for the property insurers in Charlotte's large insurance community — hurricane track modeling, wind speed and surge prediction for the Carolina coast, and the hail and wind risk analytics for Charlotte's inland severe weather market.

blocks.heading: NC DOI-compliant rate filing analytics
paragraphs: ML supporting the actuarial analytics for North Carolina Department of Insurance rate filings — the NC DOI's prior approval rate regulation creates specific actuarial documentation requirements that ML-informed rate analyses must address.

sections.title: North Carolina FinTech AI regulatory context
sections.description: Key regulatory considerations for FinTech AI development in North Carolina.

blocks.heading: North Carolina's bank regulatory environment
paragraphs: The OCC supervises BofA and Truist's national bank charters, and the Federal Reserve supervises their bank holding companies — the dual regulatory oversight creates complex compliance documentation requirements for Charlotte financial AI.

blocks.heading: CFPB consumer financial protection
paragraphs: Charlotte's large consumer lending community (BofA, Truist, LendingTree) is subject to CFPB oversight, including the CFPB's evolving guidance on AI in credit decisions and the ECOA disparate impact requirements for ML-based credit scoring.
